text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After finishing up her errand while out—
Win Variation had been roped into
a small-scale fan event."

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wah...! H-Hello!
I've always been cheering for you... so much!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm super happy!!
Thank you so much for the support! ...Yes, sir!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Um... I-I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yaho-yaho~. —Oh, you bought one too?
The new smartwatch model. Nice one~.

text_block_list.name: Tran Fan
text_block_list.text: Yes! Tran-san recommended it, so I just had to have it!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, successful conversion~. I'll tell you
which apps you should download. First off—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's been a while! So tell me,
how have things been going with... the proposal?

text_block_list.name: Buena Fan
text_block_list.text:
It worked... They accepted it, Buena-san!
It's all thanks to your encouragement!
Thank you... Truly, thank you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Wah! Thank goodness...!!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
My heart feels so full too... Fufu.
Please keep coming to cheer for me together, okay?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Even though Trainer took the time to
practice with me the other day... I'm still totally useless.)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Maybe I just didn't work hard enough, after all.
Ugh... I want to apologize to everyone who came out to see me..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Why am I always like this...
I don't have a single good quality――)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “Refusing to give up on your ideal self is what makes you amazing!”

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: (...What Trainer said back then...)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: You knew you wouldn't be able to do it well right from the start.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
(Then, what can I do right now?
—There's only one answer!)

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for always cheering me on.
I'm really glad you came.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not really good at saying
smart or witty stuff, but...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—You've been a huge help. Truly.
I'm counting on you from here on out too!

text_block_list.name: Shion Fan B
text_block_list.text:
――! Y-Yeah! Yes!
If I can be even a little help to you, Shion-kun,
then I'll keep cheering for you! Always!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh. Not bad, Bari-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Conveying your simple, honest feelings simply—
that might just be what makes someone happiest, after all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Bari-chan is great at fan service"... and noted. Got some new info~. Jotted it down!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I'm not that good, really... I just
thought I'd try to be true to myself...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: In other words, you bring joy to everyone through your wonderful personality!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Sion-san is so amazing...
I need to learn from her.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
B-Buena-san...
I'm happy you think so highly of me, but...!
choice_data_list: Man, I wanted to get some fan service too
I wanted to get some fan service too
Your hard work really showed out there.
Your hard work really showed out there.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
B-Buena-san...
I'm happy you think so highly of me, but...!
choice_data_list: Man, I wanted to get some fan service too
I wanted to get some fan service too
Your hard work really showed out there.
Your hard work really showed out there.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Y-You too, Trainer-san!?
Why would you want fan service from me...?
choice_data_list: I wanted to experience your growth firsthand, too.
I wanted to experience your growth firsthand too.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...I-I see.
Then... wanna give it another shot?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you as always!
Your cheers give me strength—fufu.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
......Um, well... why is this, I wonder?
When it's not practice, it's just... kinda embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I can't help grinning... Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. The results are in.
Our hard work really paid off.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I'm really glad I believed in you.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad...
I trusted your words, Trainer...
